observation: The browser proxy log records upstream, path, status, byte count, and time, but not forwarded request headers. Exact Chromium If-Modified-Since / If-None-Match values are therefore unavailable retrospectively.
classification: The older rollback Last-Modified combined with a 304 is strongly consistent with the conditional-date validator collision expected from the static staging server, but the missing request headers prevent proving which validator caused it. This is a staging artifact transition failure, not evidence of archive loss or a confirmed application data migration failure.
browser_profile: preserved; candidate service worker still controls http://127.0.0.1:34836/; no storage/cache clearing or worker unregister performed
